15.t: Working with data: height in a class
q: Which height class has the most students?
How many students are 170 cm or taller?
State whether height shows continuous or discontinuous variation, with a reason.
Continuous: it can take any value in a range and forms a bell-shaped curve.
Explain why height varies in this way, using genes and the environment.
Height is controlled by many genes plus the environment (diet, health, sleep). Many small effects add up to a smooth spread around the mean.
